title: SelectivePickup
description: Allows you to only pick up what you already have in your inventory so you never pickup unnecessary items when you dont want to
body:
**Selective Pickup**: When enabled, players will _only_ pick up items if they already have at least one of that item in their inventory. If your inventory has diamonds and iron, you'll only pick up those even if there are 1000 other junk items on the ground!

**Quick-Pick** (Sneak to bypass): You don't need to type a command to quickly grab an item you don't have in your inventory. Just sneak (Shift) over the item and you'll pick it up normally, whether Selective Pickup is turned on or off.

**Highly customizable**: Easy to tweak
**Performance Friendly**: Made with low-end servers in mind

**commands:**

```/selectivepickup``` toggle on and off 

```/selectivepickup reload``` reload config

**permissions:**

```selectivepickup.allow``` (default on) access to toggle on and off

```selectivepickup.admin``` enables reload config
